steps.title: Project Structuring
steps.description: Initialize the workspace directory tree and target configurations for Retro 3D Turbo Racer.

steps.title: Manifest Configuration
steps.description: Write the high-priority AndroidManifest.xml locking orientation to landscape and setting fullscreen Material theme.

steps.title: Build Script Specification
steps.description: Develop build.gradle script setting target SDK to 34 and forcing strict Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Layout Engineering
steps.description: Fix activity_main.xml layout resource error by replacing invalid match_height with match_parent.

steps.title: Custom Game View Base Setup
steps.description: Draft the SurfaceView structure in MainActivity.java managing lifecycle events and view creation.

steps.title: Pseudo-3D Projection Equations
steps.description: Program the mathematical camera equations and perspective formulas mapping 3D road elements onto a 2D screen coordinate space.

steps.title: Procedural Track Engine
steps.description: Generate looping tracks featuring variable curves, elevations, valleys, and changing zones (Desert, Forest, Mountain, Cyber City).

steps.title: Player Vehicle Physics
steps.description: Write high fidelity car physical models including centrifugal forces on curves, off-track grass friction, braking drift, and turbo mechanics.

steps.title: Collision Detection System
steps.description: Develop real-time overlap validation verifying interactions between the player car, traffic cars, static objects, fuel cans, and stars.

steps.title: Vector Graphic Renderer
steps.description: Code procedurally drawn elements utilizing Android Canvas for obstacles, customized player sports cars, and environment scenery.

steps.title: Dynamic Sound Synthesizer
steps.description: Implement real-time low-frequency engine tone synth via AudioTrack representing real gear changes and accelerating rumbles.

steps.title: High Scores & Persistent Data
steps.description: Integrate local high-score saving and loading mechanisms using Android SharedPreferences APIs.

steps.title: Comprehensive Game Loop Integration
steps.description: Tie all subsystems together, handling state transitions between start menu, playing mode, pause, and game over stages.

steps.title: Building Retro 3D Turbo Racer
steps.description: Perform gradle debug assembly checking resource integrity, layout scales, and native build files packaging.
